frames.heading: Space
frames.body: As Mojo and Player commence their epic dual with the Grand Composer, a bright light floods the galaxy!

frames.heading: Space
frames.body: Defeated by the immense power of their song, the Grand Composer combusts, spreading his energy across the galaxy.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: We did it! The Grand Composer has been defeated!!!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Zowie! My mojo, it has come back!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Now that we have saved the galaxy, we can return to our World Tour! With you as my trusty engineer, our boundless groove is unstoppable.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: But Mojo, I'm as powerful as you now! Maybe we could negotiate a... dual act?

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: But my fans, they expect me in the spotlight! You may have groove, but at the end of the day you're just an engineer.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Oh yeah? Then maybe we should have a... GROOVE OFF!!!!
